given.note: v1.4's outbox-row-written-alex-safety in its v1.16 form. After the commit that wrote Alex's emergency line as a safety row to handle-alex (v1.1's commit-alex-safety), a repeated record of the same text reads the line's row by its id: it is written, so the answer gives the recipient and send class the row stores, handle-alex and safety, which the danger wake's safety claim for handle-alex takes (K-05 v1.14 item 67). Only the row's id, recipient_handle_id and send_class are read, never its plan, final parts or the handle's number.
